Chapter 11

A letter for you

Dear Shivi,

Pata hai, main har baar perfect words nahi bol pata. Kabhi zyada soch leta hoon, kabhi apni feelings theek se express nahi kar pata. Lekin ek baat sach hai — tum mere liye bahut special ho.

Tumhari smile, tumhari baatein aur tumhare saath bitaye chhote-chhote moments mere liye bahut precious hain. Main chahta hoon ki hum ek dusre ko samjhein, respect karein aur honestly saath chalein.

Main tumse perfection nahi maangta. Bas chahta hoon ki hum real rahein, ek dusre ki khushi ka khayal rakhein, aur har din thoda aur better partner banein.

Thank you for being you. I'm happy our paths met.

With love, Raunak ♡
